(William), 1842-1903 [Contributor]") and every person the printed edition's opening pages credit; each death year is Wikidata's (Wikidata gives some of them several death years, every one 1925 or earlier: Maulana Jalal al-Din Rumi [1263, 1272, 1273]).

Printed edition: From The Divan Of Jelaleddin, 1903, the Internet Archive scan https://archive.org/details/in.ernet.dli.2015.500272. Three passages of the Gutenberg text have 67%, 44%, 89% of their four-word runs in the scan's text.
